```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(nhstt)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
```

> **Note:** The counts reflect the data we have added to the package so far and may differ from the full reports published by NHS England. For example, before 2017-18 the annual reports used a substantially different data format. We have not yet added provider level breakdowns for these years, only totals for England.

This page shows how many NHS Talking Therapies providers submitted data in each reporting period of the annual, quarterly, and monthly datasets.

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| cache: true
measures_annual <- get_measures_annual()

# Each dataset stores provider codes in a different column
provider_periods <- bind_rows(
  measures_annual |>
    filter(org_type == "Provider") |>
    distinct(reporting_period, end_date, org_code) |>
    mutate(source = "annual"),
  get_measures_quarterly() |>
    filter(org_type %in% c("Provider", "SubICB-Provider")) |>
    distinct(reporting_period, end_date, org_code = provider_code) |>
    mutate(source = "quarterly"),
  get_measures_monthly() |>
    filter(group_type %in% c("Provider", "SubICB/Provider")) |>
    distinct(reporting_period, end_date, org_code = org_code2) |>
    mutate(source = "monthly")
)

# Annual periods with only England totals, shown at zero providers
england_only_periods <- measures_annual |>
  distinct(reporting_period, end_date) |>
  anti_join(provider_periods, by = "end_date") |>
  mutate(source = "annual", n_providers = 0L, england_only = TRUE)

provider_counts <- provider_periods |>
  count(source, reporting_period, end_date, name = "n_providers") |>
  mutate(england_only = FALSE) |>
  bind_rows(england_only_periods) |>
  mutate(
    period_label = case_when(
      source == "quarterly" ~ sub("-q", "-Q", reporting_period),
      source == "monthly" ~ format(end_date, "%B %Y"),
      .default = reporting_period
    ),
    source = factor(
      source,
      levels = c("annual", "quarterly", "monthly"),
      labels = c("Annual", "Quarterly", "Monthly")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-submission-history
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: Trends of providers that submitted data in each reporting period. The labels show the total number of providers that submitted data in the latests available reporting period. The grey points at zero in the annual panel indicate the years where we have not yet added provider level breakdowns.

# Same x and y limits in every panel so the panels are easy to compare
date_limits <- range(provider_counts$end_date)
count_limits <- c(0, max(provider_counts$n_providers))

# Label the end of each financial year and tick every month
year_end_breaks <- provider_counts |>
  filter(source == "Annual") |>
  distinct(end_date) |>
  pull(end_date)

month_starts <- seq(
  as.Date(format(date_limits[1], "%Y-%m-01")),
  date_limits[2] + 1,
  by = "month"
)

# Month ends are the day before each month start
month_end_ticks <- month_starts[-1] - 1

# geom_label() aligns text with hjust, so left align from a fixed start that
# leaves room for the longest label at any date range
label_x <- date_limits[2] - 0.25 * diff(date_limits)

provider_counts |>
  split(~source) |>
  lapply(\(counts) {
    counts |>
      ggplot(aes(x = end_date, y = n_providers, colour = source)) +
      geom_line(data = \(d) filter(d, !england_only), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(data = \(d) filter(d, !england_only), size = 1) +
      geom_point(
        data = \(d) filter(d, england_only),
        size = 1,
        colour = "grey60"
      ) +
      geom_label(
        data = \(d) slice_max(d, end_date),
        aes(
          label = paste0(
            "Reporting period: ",
            period_label,
            "\nN = ",
            n_providers
          )
        ),
        x = label_x,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        nudge_y = -15,
        size = 3.5,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      scale_x_date(
        breaks = year_end_breaks,
        minor_breaks = month_end_ticks,
        labels = label_date("%b\n%Y"),
        limits = date_limits
      ) +
      guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_number(accuracy = 1),
        limits = count_limits
      ) +
      # Keep all levels so each source gets the same colour in every panel
      scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", drop = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = unique(counts$source),
        x = "End date of reporting period",
        y = "Number of NHS TT providers"
      )
  }) |>
  wrap_plots(ncol = 1, axis_titles = "collect") &
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "gray90", linetype = "dotted"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```
